name: 3 ft. x 4 ft. electric in-floor heated underlayment for laminate, engineered wood, carpet & vinyl flooring - ThermoFloor 240V
description: Our USA-made, ETL-listed radiant heated underlayment is easy to DIY install - no messy thinset required! Mfg-direct phone support and a 10-year transferable warranty ensure a worry-free purchase and installation. These hermetically sealed, 1/8" thin heating pads should be combined and arranged to fit your heated area like puzzle pieces (without overlap). Any remaining areas should be filled with unheated underlayment. ThermoSoft electric floor heat is an affordable, maintenance-free luxury that can lower your energy bills while being silent and hypoallergenic.

name: Cadet CBC103T 3415 BTU 120/240 Volt Wall Mounted Bathroom Heater from the Com-Pa
description: Turn your drafty bathroom into a cozy haven using the Cadet Com-Pak Bath Wall Fan Heater. Unlike large heaters you have to make floor space for, this powerful fan-forced heating system takes up no floor space at all seeing as it is designed for in-wall installation. The low profile grill is only a half inch deep, barely even protruding from your wall. It is powder coated in a soft white paint that eliminates sharp edges and will blend in rather than draw attention. This unit arrives with all parts ready to be implemented, including a wall can that will speed up the installation process. No need to buy a thermostat, this unit has an integrated thermostat for easy heat adjustment as well as a 60 minute timer for quick warmth. For added safety measures, there is a thermal safeguard that will ensure the unit shuts off at unsafe temperatures. Constructed of quality components like steel and made in the USA, you can rest assured that this heater is made to last. Although it is ideal for bathrooms, you can place this efficient heating system in any room of your home.
